compiler:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.6.3.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.2.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
measurement_policy: Function-level MVT, initialized deterministic data; native warm-up traversal then reset outside each individually timed ROI, batches sum ROI times; simulator initializes data and warms tags in allocation order, then clears counters. Times are cycles / assumed frequency. No frequency or P/E correction.
limitations: Provisional evaluation pipeline evidence, not a calibrated/validated hardware profile.
Native core identity and instantaneous frequency are unknown; hardware counters unavailable.
Native and simulated cache-start states are not proven equivalent, especially above cache capacity.
Function bytes match, but native and simulated virtual addresses/alignment need not match.
Legacy MVT informed earlier model development; these are future-calibration cases, not independent holdouts.
Timer overhead is reported, not subtracted; very short ROIs have limited timing precision.
